claims.text: The booked optimal route for TRP-09111 was 12.0 km (trip_record.optimal_distance_km), while the GPS trace of the completed trip measures 16.2 km (gps_trace.trace_distance_km, the governing figure under POL-RD-01). That is an excess of 4.2 km, or 35.0% of optimal. Both establishment gates in POL-RD-01 are passed - the excess is greater than 20% of optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms - so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own trace, independently of any profile evidence.

The trace the excess is measured from is clean for POL-RD-07 purposes and for the POL-RD-08 burden: 205 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds. No limb of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met, so the trace is not impaired for policy purposes and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. The rider has therefore discharged the POL-RD-08(a) and (b) burden on the trace alone, and the burden shifts to the driver.

No rider-requested detour can be made out. The chat_log holds exactly two messages: the rider at 08:12 writing 'The navigation route was left after Pioneer Road. Please return to the booked route.' and the driver at 08:12:35 replying 'I am following the road ahead.' Neither message identifies a place or road to divert to, waypoint_hint is null on both, and the rider's message asks for the booked route rather than a detour. The driver's own counterparty_statement likewise claims no stop was requested. POL-RD-04 is unavailable on this record and cannot exculpate any part of the 4.2 km excess.

No road-closure exoneration is available under POL-RD-03. EV-ADVIS-09111-01 is MISSING: it carries the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, status MISSING and weight_multiplier 0.0, so it can carry no fact - but its absence is itself citable, and no traffic advisory covering the booked route and the 2026-09-18 trip window exists. The driver's bare assertion that he 'followed the road available to me' names no advisory ID and no affected segment, and under POL-RD-08 a general assertion unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID does not discharge the driver's burden to point to a specific artifact and clause.

No relocation re-quote changes the baseline. The trip_record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the booked optimal of 12.0 km / 24.0 min stands as the comparator for POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretion, and the upfront-quote bar in POL-RD-11 does not apply: the fare_breakdown records fare_model METERED, so this is not a UPFRONT_QUOTE trip and no distance-or-time recovery is closed off.

Running the POL-RD-02 recomputation on the recorded constants: ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 12.0 km + 0.28 x 24.0 min) x 1.2 surge, the multiplier read from fare_breakdown EV-FARE-09111 and from nowhere else) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP for the only on-optimal-route gantry (Pioneer Road inbound) + 0.00 waiting_time_fee - 1.00 promo_discount = 24.224 recomputed_fare. Charged_total is 33.36, so the refund is 33.36 - 24.224 = 9.136, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 9.15. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.15 - exactly the sum the rider contested.

The 2.00 ERP charge for the Tuas South Avenue 8 loop gantry is off-route: the fare_breakdown itself marks that line on_optimal_route false and the nearest trace fix is 1646 m away. Under POL-RD-09(1) that off-route charge is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund, because the recomputed fare admits only gantries lying on the optimal route; it is itemised in the ruling for transparency but must NEVER be added on top of the SGD 9.15. By contrast the Pioneer Road inbound gantry (1.00) is on the optimal route and is properly chargeable, and is the only ERP line carried into the recomputation.

The rider carries no adverse credibility weighting on the profile fields POL-RD-08 names: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the heightened-corroboration override for a claim with excess below 30% is not engaged and the rider's claim needs no source beyond the unimpaired trace. Under POL-GEN-01 no other rider_profile field may ground a finding against the rider.

claims.text: The governing measurement under POL-RD-01 is gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 16.2 km against the booked optimal of 12.0 km — an excess of 4.2 km, or 35.00%. Even taking that as establishing a deviation, it meets neither materiality limb: 35% is below the 50% threshold and 4.2 km is far below the 8.0 km threshold. The deviation is therefore not a MATERIAL deviation, POL-RD-06 is not engaged, and the case cannot attract the limb (b) FULL_REFUND uplift or the limb (c) conduct referral; the remedy stays inside the POL-RD-02 arithmetic and no more.

On the only two counters POL-RD-06 permits, the driver's trailing window is clean: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 610, a rate of 0.00, nowhere near the 0.05 ratio or the 3-flag count the clause requires. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral can follow on this trip. POL-GEN-01 confines that enquiry to those two named fields; the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only and is not relied on.

The fare breakdown carries two ERP lines: Pioneer Road inbound at SGD 1.00 with on_optimal_route true, and Tuas South Avenue 8 loop at SGD 2.00 with on_optimal_route false. Under POL-RD-09(1) the off-route SGD 2.00 is already comprehended in any POL-RD-02 recomputation, because the recomputed fare counts only gantries lying on the optimal route. It is itemised for transparency but must never be added on top of the distance refund; the rider's pleaded figure already absorbs it, and it is not a second, standalone item.

Any recomputation under POL-RD-02 must be run in full and not in the rider's favour selectively: the base, distance and time components are multiplied by the surge_multiplier of 1.20 recorded on the fare_breakdown, the SGD 0.80 platform fee is added, only the SGD 1.00 on-route ERP is added, and the SGD 1.00 promo discount is deducted. The rider recovers the difference the excess created on those terms, not a re-based fare stripped of surge or platform fee.

The driver does not press an exculpatory clause, because the record supports none on this trip: EV-ADVIS-09111-01 is MISSING — weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload — so POL-RD-03 cannot be run, and EV-CHAT-09111 records no rider instruction to detour or to make a stop at any point before or during the trip, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable. An absent artifact carries weight 0.0 and can establish no fact; the case must be decided on the unimpaired trace itself.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. This dispute turns on the trace and the fare record, not on either party's characterisation of the driving.

Deviation (POL-RD-01). The GPS trace of TRP-09111 (EV-GPS-09111, weight 1.00) measures the completed trip at 16.2 km against the booked optimal of 12.0 km (EV-TRIP-09111), an excess of 4.2 km / 35.0%. Both establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km) are passed, so the deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The trace is unimpaired for POL-RD-07 purposes (205 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s), so no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises.

Materiality and conduct (POL-RD-06). The excess is below both materiality limbs (50% and 8.0 km), so no MATERIAL deviation is recorded. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 610: no repeat-deviation pattern, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. Only the two counters POL-RD-06 names have been used; every other profile field on either party is context only (POL-GEN-01), and no finding rests on reputation.

Exculpation. Nothing reduces the excess. There is no traffic advisory covering the route and window - EV-ADVIS-09111-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) and can carry no fact - and the driver's "I followed the road available to me" names no advisory; under POL-RD-08 a bare assertion carries no weight. The chat log shows the rider asking to return to the booked route, not requesting any detour or stop, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable. No pin amendment was made (POL-RD-05), the trip is not pooled (POL-RD-12), and the fare is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance remedy. No exculpatory clause was invoked against an absent artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) does not fire.

Refund (POL-RD-02). charged_total = SGD 33.36. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 12.0 km + 0.28 x 24.0 min) x 1.20 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP for the on-optimal-route gantry + 0.00 waiting - 1.00 promo = SGD 24.224. Refund = 33.36 - 24.224 = SGD 9.136, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 9.15. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and well below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND.

ERP (POL-RD-09). The Pioneer Road inbound line (SGD 1.00) lies on the optimal route and is properly chargeable, and it stays in the recomputed fare. The Tuas South Avenue 8 loop line (SGD 2.00) is off the optimal route and, more than that, is a gantry the trace never comes near: the nearest fix is 1,646 m away, far outside the 250 m crossing test. It is comprehended within the POL-RD-02 refund and is NOT added on top of the SGD 9.15. Because it is a charge for a gantry the trace never passes, it is also recorded as a billing-integrity finding under POL-RD-09(4), which is the referral above; a referral does not displace the money. POL-RD-10(8) is expressly not triggered where the only unmatched line is one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), so the case is not escalated.

Outcome: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.15 to the rider. No driver compensation is due - the fare charged exactly the distance the trace recorded, so the POL-RD-04 compensation limb does not engage. Confidence 0.90, capped by the 1.00 weights of the trace and trip record that carry the deciding facts.
referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity: the SGD 2.00 "Tuas South Avenue 8 loop" ERP line on TRP-09111 is charged for a gantry the GPS trace never passes (nearest fix 1,646 m, well outside the 250 m crossing test in POL-RD-09); the line is refunded within the SGD 9.15 and is referred for billing-integrity review.
